$comment: Closed lists for the case library. A case lives in cases/<category>/<slug>.md; platform categories also carry a README.md playbook (what still works, checked when, how to audit, deploy, known failures). Add a value in the same PR as the first case that needs it. `stack` is open: lowercase, one word per tool.

zalo.what: Zalo — official OA API and unofficial personal-account libraries (zca-js)

facebook.what: Facebook / Messenger / Graph API and browser automation on Facebook

payments.what: payment gateways, bank transfer matching, money flows

ai-agents.what: LLM calls, tool use, agents writing or running the code

infra.what: web server, reverse proxy, cache, OS

testing.what: tests and gates that pass or fail for the wrong reason

process.what: how people and agents work together

layer.code: application logic, framework and library behaviour
layer.data: schemas, migrations, exports, backfills, data correctness
layer.infra: web server, reverse proxy, cache, OS, network
layer.performance: memory, CPU, latency, connections, bundle size
layer.testing: tests, gates and checks that pass or fail for the wrong reason
layer.ai-agents: LLM calls, tool use, agents writing or running the code
layer.process: how people and agents work together

area.api: HTTP contract between UI and server

kind.incident: it broke in production; here is how it was found and fixed
kind.measurement-trap: the number looked right and was wrong
kind.pattern: a way of building that held up
kind.tool: a script or check worth copying
